newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-GOAL-SHY SWISS RESCUED BY KUNZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOAL-SHY SWISS RESCUED BY KUNZ.

text.p: Adrian Kunz came off the bench to score in injury time and lift Switzerland to a 1-0 win over Latvia in an international friendly on Wednesday.
Kunz, who replaced David Sesa in the 80th minute, pounced on his own rebound inside the penalty area and blasted a low shot into an open net seconds before the final whistle.

It was the final outing for Switzerland before a crucial World Cup group three qualifying match against Hungary at the end of the month and they dominated throughout, particularly after the interval when Latvia seldom ventured out of their own half.
But the Swiss lacked a finishing touch around the Latvia goal, unable to capitalise on any of dozen solid scoring opportunities until Kunz's late heroics.
